import sys,json,hashlib,math
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/tommy0929/Documents/imgo2')
sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT/'imgo2_rl/source/imgo2_rl'),str(ROOT/'imgo2_rl/scripts/rl_lab')]
from isaaclab.app import AppLauncher
app=AppLauncher(headless=True,device='cuda:0').app
import torch
import gymnasium as gym
import imgo2_rl.tasks
from isaaclab_tasks.utils.parse_cfg import load_cfg_from_registry
from imgo2_rl.tasks.manager_based.locomotion.velocity import mdp
import play_utils
report={};env=None
try:
 cfg=load_cfg_from_registry('Imgo2-basemove-rough-ppo','env_cfg_entry_point')
 cfg.seed=42;cfg.sim.device='cuda:0';cfg.scene.num_envs=64
 cfg.scene.terrain.terrain_type='plane';cfg.scene.terrain.terrain_generator=None
 for k in vars(cfg.curriculum):
  if not k.startswith('_'):setattr(cfg.curriculum,k,None)
 for k,v in vars(cfg.events).items():
  if v is not None and getattr(v,'mode','') in ('startup','interval'):setattr(cfg.events,k,None)
 # 直接执行接入文档中的Python块，检查提供给用户的配置与真实课程接线。
 import re
 blocks=re.findall(r'```python\n(.*?)```',(ROOT/'docs/training/ppo_grouped_command_sampling_plan_2026-11-05.md').read_text(),re.S)
 namespace={'self':cfg};exec(blocks[0],namespace);exec(blocks[1],namespace)
 play_utils.disable_command_debug_visualizers(cfg)
 env=gym.make('Imgo2-basemove-rough-ppo',cfg=cfg);u=env.unwrapped;env.reset();term=u.command_manager.get_term('base_velocity');ids=torch.arange(u.num_envs,device=u.device)
 assert isinstance(term,mdp.GroupedVelocityCommand)
 assert cfg.curriculum.command_levels_lin_vel is not None and cfg.curriculum.command_levels_ang_vel is not None
 assert abs(float(u._initial_vel_x[1])-.6)<1e-5 and abs(float(u._final_vel_x[1])-1.2)<1e-5
 assert abs(float(u._initial_ang_vel_z[1])-.75)<1e-5 and abs(float(u._final_ang_vel_z[1])-1.5)<1e-5
 report['documented_configuration_and_curriculums_instantiated']=True
 counts=torch.zeros(3,device=u.device,dtype=torch.long);directions=torch.zeros(6,device=u.device,dtype=torch.long)
 torch.manual_seed(42)
 for _ in range(256):
  term._resample_command(ids);v=term.command.clone();groups=term.sampled_group;low=groups==1;stand=groups==0
  counts+=torch.bincount(groups,minlength=3);directions+=torch.bincount(term.sampled_low_direction[low],minlength=6)
  assert bool((v[stand]==0).all())
  assert bool(((v[low]!=0).sum(dim=1)==1).all())
  ds=term.sampled_low_direction[low];axes=ds//2;vals=v[low].gather(1,axes[:,None]).squeeze(1);sign=torch.where(ds%2==0,1.,-1.)
  assert bool((vals*sign>0).all())
  assert bool((vals.abs()>=term._low_min[axes]-1e-6).all()) and bool((vals.abs()<=term._low_max[axes]+1e-6).all())
  assert torch.equal(term.is_standing_env,stand)
  term._update_command();assert torch.equal(v,term.command)
 n=int(counts.sum());probs=(counts/n).cpu().tolist();assert max(abs(p-q) for p,q in zip(probs,[.1,.4,.5]))<.02
 assert max(abs(float(x/directions.sum())-1/6) for x in directions)<.03
 report.update(samples=n,group_counts=counts.cpu().tolist(),group_probabilities=probs,low_direction_counts=directions.cpu().tolist())
 # 部分重置不能改写其他环境的组、方向或指令；空批次必须可用。
 before=[x.clone() for x in (term.command,term.sampled_group,term.sampled_low_direction)];subset=ids[[1,5,9]];other=torch.ones(u.num_envs,dtype=torch.bool,device=u.device);other[subset]=False
 term._resample_command(subset)
 for old,new in zip(before,(term.command,term.sampled_group,term.sampled_low_direction)):assert torch.equal(old[other],new[other])
 before=term.command.clone();term._resample_command([]);assert torch.equal(before,term.command)
 # 相同seed可复现；课程范围变动仅影响宽范围，保护组不被缩小。
 torch.manual_seed(123);term._resample_command(ids);v=term.command.clone();g=term.sampled_group.clone()
 torch.manual_seed(123);term._resample_command(ids);assert torch.equal(v,term.command)
 original=(term.cfg.ranges.lin_vel_x,term.cfg.ranges.lin_vel_y,term.cfg.ranges.ang_vel_z)
 term.cfg.ranges.lin_vel_x=(-.12,.12);term.cfg.ranges.lin_vel_y=(-.08,.08);term.cfg.ranges.ang_vel_z=(-.15,.15)
 torch.manual_seed(123);term._resample_command(ids);assert torch.equal(g,term.sampled_group);assert torch.equal(v[g!=2],term.command[g!=2]);assert bool((term.command[g==2,:2]==0).all())
 term.cfg.ranges.lin_vel_x,term.cfg.ranges.lin_vel_y,term.cfg.ranges.ang_vel_z=original
 # 配置拒绝易产生双重覆盖/无效概率/死区的用法。
 invalid=[dict(heading_command=True),dict(rel_standing_envs=.1),dict(standing_group_probability=.8,low_speed_group_probability=.4),dict(low_lin_vel_x=(.1,.5)),dict(low_ang_vel_z=(.5,.2)),dict(low_speed_group_probability=float('nan'))]
 for update in invalid:
  try:mdp.GroupedVelocityCommand(term.cfg.replace(**update),u)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError(update)
 # 概率边界：全静止/全低速/全宽范围，覆盖没有低速环境的空张量路径。
 for sp,lp,expected in [(1.,0.,0),(0.,1.,1),(0.,0.,2)]:
  t=mdp.GroupedVelocityCommand(term.cfg.replace(standing_group_probability=sp,low_speed_group_probability=lp),u);t._resample_command(ids);assert bool((t.sampled_group==expected).all());t._update_command()
 for _ in range(10):env.step(torch.zeros((u.num_envs,12),device=u.device))
 report.update(real_environment_steps=10,device=str(u.device),num_envs=u.num_envs,partial_reset=True,empty_batch=True,parent_update_preserves_commands_on_plane=True,seed_reproducible=True,low_ranges_protected_from_curriculum=True,invalid_configs_rejected=len(invalid),probability_boundary_cases=3,passed=True)
 p=ROOT/'imgo2_rl/source/imgo2_rl/imgo2_rl/tasks/manager_based/locomotion/velocity/mdp/commands.py';report['commands_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();report['verification_source']=Path(__file__).read_text()
 (ROOT/'docs/training/grouped_velocity_command_verification_2026-11-05.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print('GROUPED_CHECK_PASSED',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='verification_source'}))
finally:
 if env is not None:env.close()
 app.close()
